---
title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard"
author: "Lehiwa Wong-Frank"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
```

# Page 1

### Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

### Row 2

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass

flipper_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(flipper_by_mass)
```

```{r}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass

bill_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(bill_by_mass)
```

# Data Table

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |>  
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
